set.body:
Outcome
Make the theme reproducibly buildable and usable from Java or Scala.

Owned scope
build.sbt; project; tokens; theme module; notices

Prerequisites
A1, A2, A3

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A1–A3 pass with exact versions and source provenance.
- [ ] A clean build launches the initial native themed scene and resolves a coherent JavaFX 27 runtime.
- [ ] Generated resources and metrics are deterministic; palette relationships and the minimal control state set pass.

Required evidence
A1–A3 build, generation, parser, runtime and contrast receipts.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code E0. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [E0] Establish the pinned native theme foundation
